title: Codewars 8kyu: Convert a Boolean to a String
description: Implement a function which converts the given boolean value into its string representation. (e.g. True -> 'true', False -> 'false').
constraints:
b is a boolean
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
solution:
def boolean_to_string(b: bool) -> str:
    return 'true' if b else 'false'
explanation: Converts boolean flag to lowercase string representation.
